title: Price vs VWAP
description: Where the price sits against the volume-weighted average of recent trades. Trading far from where the volume happened tends to pull back toward it.

vwap_60s.label: VWAP 60s
vwap_60s.description: The average trade price over the last minute, weighted by size, in dollars. It is where the money actually changed hands.

deviation_bps_10s.label: Deviation 10s
deviation_bps_10s.description: How far the midpoint is above or below the ten-second VWAP, in basis points. Positive means trading above where the volume happened.

deviation_bps_60s.label: Deviation 60s
deviation_bps_60s.description: The same distance against the one-minute VWAP, in basis points. A larger, slower read of the same stretch.
